<!-- HERO -->
<div class="hero">
  <div class="hero-tag">ISSS608 · Visual Analytics Project · AY2025-26</div>
  <h1>Fin<span>Sight</span></h1>
  <p>A web-enabled visual analytics application for democratising customer intelligence in Colombian fintech — built with R Shiny.</p>
  <div class="hero-btns">
    <a href="Project_Proposal.html" class="btn-primary">Read Proposal</a>
    <a href="about.html" class="btn-outline">Meet the Team</a>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- INTRO -->
<div class="section">
  <div class="section-label">What we built</div>
  <div class="section-title">Four modules. One application.</div>
  <p class="section-sub">FinSight integrates exploratory analysis, statistical testing, latent class clustering, and predictive modelling into a single interactive Shiny app.</p>
  <div class="intro-grid">
    <div class="intro-card">
      <div class="intro-icon">📊</div>
      <h4>Exploratory Data Analysis</h4>
      <p>Visualise customer demographics, product adoption, churn distribution and satisfaction patterns interactively.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="intro-card">
      <div class="intro-icon">🔬</div>
      <h4>Confirmatory Data Analysis</h4>
      <p>Run Pearson correlation, ANOVA, and multiple linear regression to statistically validate key relationships.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="intro-card">
      <div class="intro-icon">🧩</div>
      <h4>Clustering — LCA</h4>
      <p>Discover 5 latent customer segments using Latent Class Analysis across 18 behavioural and attitudinal variables.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="intro-card">
      <div class="intro-icon">🌳</div>
      <h4>Decision Tree & Random Forest</h4>
      <p>Predict customer segment membership using rpart and ranger, with interactive parameter tuning and model comparison.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="section-dark">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="section-label">The application</div>
    <div class="section-title">Shiny App Modules</div>

    <div class="modules-grid">

      <div class="mod-card">
        <div class="mod-header">
          <div class="mod-num">Tab 01</div>
          <h3>Exploratory Data Analysis</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="mod-body">
          <p>Interactive histograms, correlation heatmap, faceted scatter plots by income and gender, satisfaction trends by CLV and tenure.</p>
          <div class="mod-tags">
            <span class="tag">ggplot2</span>
            <span class="tag">plotly</span>
            <span class="tag">ggcorrplot</span>
          </div>
          <a href="#" target="_blank" class="mod-link">▶ Open in App</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="mod-card">
        <div class="mod-header">
          <div class="mod-num">Tab 02</div>
          <h3>Confirmatory Data Analysis</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="mod-body">
          <p>Pearson correlation tests, one-way and two-way ANOVA, multiple linear regression with interactive variable selection and model comparison.</p>
          <div class="mod-tags">
            <span class="tag">broom</span>
            <span class="tag">ggplot2</span>
            <span class="tag">patchwork</span>
          </div>
          <a href="#" target="_blank" class="mod-link">▶ Open in App</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="mod-card">
        <div class="mod-header">
          <div class="mod-num">Tab 03</div>
          <h3>Clustering — LCA</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="mod-body">
          <p>Latent Class Analysis with adjustable classes and repetitions. BIC, AIC, entropy metrics. Interactive stacked bar charts for all 18 variables.</p>
          <div class="mod-tags">
            <span class="tag">poLCA</span>
            <span class="tag">plotly</span>
            <span class="tag">tidyverse</span>
          </div>
          <a href="#" target="_blank" class="mod-link">▶ Open in App</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="mod-card">
        <div class="mod-header">
          <div class="mod-num">Tab 04</div>
          <h3>Decision Tree & Random Forest</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="mod-body">
          <p>Pruned classification tree and random forest with interactive parameter tuning. Variable importance plot and confusion matrix comparison.</p>
          <div class="mod-tags">
            <span class="tag">rpart</span>
            <span class="tag">ranger</span>
            <span class="tag">caret</span>
          </div>
          <a href="#" target="_blank" class="mod-link">▶ Open in App</a>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
